details.title: Reverse Lunge - OPEX Exercise Library
details.author: OPEX Fitness
details.shortDescription:
Start the Reverse Lunge with feet hip-width apart, take a step backward with the right foot and then slowly bend both knees until the back knee is just above the floor, returning to the start position, then take a step backward with the left foot and bend both knees until the back knee is just above the floor, returning to the start position

details.title: Exercise Tutorial: Bodyweight Step-Up
details.author: Travis Tarrant
details.shortDescription:
Stand in front of a step that is knee high.
Put a foot on the step and lift yourself up using only this leg.
Keep the knee aligned, torso straight and do not push with the free leg between reps.

details.title: Glute Bridge - OPEX Exercise Library
details.author: OPEX Fitness
details.shortDescription:
The glute bridge starts lying on your back. Keep you feet flat on the floor and squeeze your glutes to raise your pelvis off the floor. Then keep your glutes squeezed and hold the position for the duration of the exercise.
